text: {"lessons":["I sold Stocks B, E and D for gains, but a gain relative to my cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should judge each holding by its future risk and return.","Avoiding a sale because it would realize a loss lets my purchase price drive decisions. I should reassess losing positions just as objectively as winners.","Recent price changes do not predict what comes next, so I should not trade on a short run of gains or declines; I should keep a diversified portfolio and trade only when my plan calls for it."]}
